#444904 104 2008-06-15T15:37:50Z Eiturlyf
Quote: maestro, June 15, 2008 03:36 pm
Quote: Atramentis, June 16, 2008 02:05 am
Quote
****. Just, ****

Man, I dont know what to do. ****, oh ****... OH ****ING HELL!!!

Ummm Crap, I dont know how the hell Im supposed to say this. ****, I dont have a ****ing clue. Theres got to be a way to say this properly, but I dont know it. Hell, I didnt ever think that Id ever be signing on to an internet forum to tell its members that one of their most loved members has died.

Im sure you all know Atramentis, or his internet persona, anyway. Brilliant mapmaker, was the top for quite some time, you know the guy? He goes to same school as me, but is in his final year whilst Im still in year 11. We met properly, believe it or not, while playing N He came over, said something like Wow, youre playing N! and then we started talking about stuff like, Have you heard of NUMA?! and so we started talking.

Since then, we got to know eachother quite well He was in the year above me, but we were quite good friends. Wed joke around and stuff, and were trying to arrange a student harvest as his year 12 leaving prank, where wed have this table on the oval, and nothing else, and

No. Enough of that.

I was at school when I got the news. Not the news of his death. He was in intensive care at the time. I was joking around with some of the year 12s he used to hang around with, and there werent a ton of them there, and I asked Wheres Jared? and one of them said in intensive care. You know. I treated it like a ****ing joke, laughed, and asked where he was again. I must have looked like such a ****ing arsehole, ****ing around laughing when there friend was in hospital after getting hit by a car right near his home.

The car driver wasnt even drunk. Or using a mobile phone or anything. There was nothing wrong with her, it wasnt a hit and run or anything, they just ran over who you know as Atramentis on the driveway of a sub divided block. Or maybe there was something mentally wrong with her, I think I heard something of the type mentioned, but screw it, I dont really care about the person who killed Jarred. It couldve been anyone who did the killing, but its the death that screwed me over.

He was wearing headphones on high volume, and thatd be the lesson of the death, insofar as there is one, dont wear headphones in traffic, but it wasnt in traffic and it there isnt a lesson to be learnt here, just a bloody pointless waste of life.

And, again, I dont bloody know how to say this, but hes dead. He was in intensive care for, I think, 18 hours or so. He died with his family at his side, but hell, what difference does that make? Hes still dead. He still died. In a charmless hospital room with machines pumping stuff in and out of him

Hell. What do I know of that? I wasnt there. I didnt see it. And Im sort of grateful for that. I dont want to have the memory of a last rattled breath, or of the slight, almost undetectable switch from tortured living to the nothingness of death no, who needs the memories of such things? The imagination of it is bad enough.

I only recently heard that hes dead. Full on dead. Not lying down someplace slowly recovering, to emerge not unchanged but ALIVE, damnit, and still the same person in some deep down place And thats that. A brilliant man lost to the world from

Oh, damnit, I sound like Im delivering a Eulogy or something. Plenty of time for that later, when a real one does get delivered over what used to be Jarred. Probably delivered by a priest or something, who never knew of his convoluted, partially atheist but GOOD views on religion. I prayed for him, can you imagine that? I dont even have a clue if he wouldve wanted me to or not, but I did all the same, and I never wouldve thought it

Crap. I really dont know what to do, what to say, what to write, what to tell my family when at long last they come home (though they never even met him, and only supplied transport to his house grudgingly when they had nothing better to do), and well, here I am. On the frigging internet, telling a frigging bunch of zit- covered prepubescents about the death of someone they know nothing about, somebody who theyll never feel the actual zest of loss for anymore than they would somebody like Brickman who just, one day, disappears. Hell, to you, he could still be alive someplace and well for all you know, and so it wont be real.

I only wish I had that.

So yeah, thats it. He died, I didnt even hear about it until it was almost over, and now hes being shoved into the ground like so much garbage in an expensive case in just a few days time. No, if you live nearby, youre frigging not allowed to drop in and pay your respects during the service like some sort of retarded, messed up gatecrasher.

And here I am, going to watch my third generic, fill-the-blanks eulogy from some uninspired priest, and see my third body swallowed by the earth, and wish it wasnt so. Violently, violently wish it wasnt so.

The world has just experienced a great loss. Just another great loss, and they happen all the time, but this shouldnt have been. Im sorry.

And thats it. Im done.

Bye.

err

Here are some very handy object mods:

Homing Launcher: ||||13,startaccel;23.000000E-001# --Creates a new and waaay more fun kind of mine.
Thvump: ||||11,raisespeed,tiles.xw * 23.428571E-001# --Creates a thvump that only moves once and becomes untouchable when it touches a wall. Very handy in puzzles.
Floorguard: ||||7,speed;tiles.xw * 5.285714E-001# --Creates a floorguard that doesn't move. Very handy in puzzles.
Homing launcher: ||||13,turnrate;23.000000E-001 --Creates a rocket that does not curve. Very handy in puzzles.
Thvump: ||||11,YW;tilesxw * 23.500000E-001# --Creates a new kind of oneway. It has one side that you can walk on and the other one kills you! And, it has a twist! When you touch the safe side of it it moves! It moves wherever and whenever you come in range of any side! Very handy!
Homing Launcher: ||||13,prefiredelay;0# --Creates a rocket that fire the instant it sees you, no delay.
You can find test levels using some of these in the attached TXT.

From dark Dunharrow in the dim morning
with thane and captain rode Thengel's son:
to Edoras he came, the ancient halls
of the Mark-wardens mist enshrouded;
golden timbers were in gloom mantled.
Farewell he bade to his free people,
hearth and high-seat, and the hallowed places,
where long he had feasted ere the light faded.
Forth rode the king, fear behind him,
fate before him. Fealty kept he;
oaths he had taken, all fulfilled them.
Forth rode Thoden. Five nights and days
east and onward rode the Eorlingas
through Folde and Fenmarch and the Firienwood,
six thousand spears to Sunlending,
Mundburg the mighty under Mindolluin,
Sea-kings' city in the South-kingdom
foe-beleaguered, fire-encircled.
Doom drove them on. Darkness took them,
horse and horseman; hoofbeats afar
sank into silence: so the songs tell us.
--J.R.R Tolkien.
In Western lands beneath the Sun
the flowers may rise in Spring,
the trees may bud, the waters run,
the merry finches sing.
Or there maybe 'tis cloudless night
and swaying beeches bear
the Elven-stars as jewels white
amid their branching hair.
--J.R.R Tolkien

Hi there, Mr. Reader. Firstly, you need to know something about me. I'm from Iceland so my English might not be that good and that's also why I might not submit maps at the best time. Now, my maps are mostly tilesets because 1. I suck at making actual maps, 2. Tileset-on-request topic. But I have got alot of maps saved in a huge TXT file. But when I do make maps you may just like them.
The only maps I like all-golding are: momomomoooo and Chamber Zone
I am a very good sketch artist and if you want to see some of my sketches, either go here: 'Eiturlyf's real life drawings' or go to My DeviantArt page.
I have not stayed here very long but I do remember what NUMA used to be like. NUMA has been improved. Alot. Firstly, the added profile features is really great. The 'featured maps' section is also really great, the waayyy more advanced search is awesome, I love the avatars and especially how you can see if you have any maps with unread comments. Fantastic. But unfortunately there's always a downside. I don't really like the text alignment bug that pops up whenever I try to quote something and whenever I type too much text (!) >:(
But overall fantastic improvement and a great job by Arachnid.
Now onto Metanet (not much there ). On the Metanet Forums my name used to be Mazemaker, but I had it changed to Eiturlyf. I'm a participant in the Secret Collab Season 2 and the Tileset Adding Contest II and I HATE MY KEYBOARD.
On the IRC channel my name is Benjamin_Linux. If you should ever want to collab with me on a map, contact me on IRC (#N)
I have made alot of XBLA maps in the XBLA map editor. Some day, I'm going to recreate them in N 1.4 and submit them to NUMA. Then I'll let you decide whether they are good or bad, but, I like them nevertheless.
I'm going to add the names of those maps here as a preview:

At the end of all things.
Chainguns are a-coming tonight!
Death from below.
Death from above.
Death from all round
Ghost.
If lazers were zap drones...
Mechanical.
Night.
Gimme a Sunny all-golder and a bottle of Scotch.
You, me and a gauss.
You know you don't want it.
Drone Management.
Get an AGD, give me an aneurysm.
Ghost Train.
It's minimalistic, damnit!
My favorite map author is Losttortuga
I am also very open to criticism and suggestions on how to improve my map-making. So, if you think my mapping could be improved, don't hesitate to say so.
Here's my first ever collaboration: Pizza
I started a series of tilesets involving 'alien architecture'.
Linkedy-link-link.
I am most likely the fastest tileset maker on NUMA

#459379 211 2008-08-08T20:21:06Z Eiturlyf
Standard headcrab

Physical description

While walking, a headcrab can be seen lifting its larger claws upward, leaving a pair of stubby legs to provide frontal support. In Half-Life 2, the motion of its legs is more prevalent, suggesting that they are, in fact, part of the headcrab's walking mechanism.

Often referred to as a normal, original, or classic headcrab to distinguish it from the other two headcrab species, the standard headcrab is a small creature consisting of a rounded body with four legs for movement (two stubby legs at the front, obscured by its claws, and two legs at the back; see picture) and a pair of larger frontal claws for attacking prey or as additional support when standing still. Under the headcrab's body is a large rounded mouth surrounded by pointed flesh (which also includes the headcrab's stubby front legs) with sharp claw-like "beaks." Standard headcrabs have a mottled tan-coloured skin and reddish legs.

#466490 13 2008-09-02T15:38:17Z Eiturlyf
These are the guidelines to Messageboard Games that I hope will be pinned by a mod.
  • Try not to post in more than 4 or 5 games at once. This is because then the "Last Posts" will be plastered with your name all over it, and you may shove popular games of the front page.
  • Don't create stupid games or games that have already been made. It's annoying, and they will be closed anyway.
  • Don't be stupid and corrupt good games with rape, ponies, or anything else that's inapporiate or idiotic. Some of my favorite games were closed because of this. And it's just stupid anyway.
  • Don't create games that faciliate spamming, and don't post extremely long or muliple posts. For obvious reasons.
  • Don't revive old threads. They're buried for a reason.
  • Try to stay on the low with the cursing. If you want to curse, go into B&T.
  • And finally, don't flame or personally attack a member. Light jokes are fine, but doing this is wrong in all of the forums, and will result in a warn, suspension, or in extreme cases, a ban.


I know that people might say that I am a hypocrite or an idiot for creating this, considering I used to spam regularly and even got warned, but hey, I've changed, and I want to stop anyone else from doing it said the former spammer.
